title: calycadenia multiglandulosa subsp. cephalotes
intro: Calycadenia multiglandulosa subsp. cephalotes, commonly known as the San Luis Valley Marsh Sunflower, is a plant species native to the southwestern United States. This plant is known for its potential medicinal properties and is used in traditional herbal remedies. The San Luis Valley Marsh Sunflower has been used to support respiratory health and may help to soothe coughs and colds due to its expectorant properties. Research has identified bioactive constituents such as flavonoids and phenolic acids that may contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects.
